configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Everything every preset agrees on. binaryDir uses ${presetName}, so a preset's name and its build directory cannot drift apart -- scripts/common.sh names those trees as $AAV_BUILD_ROOT/<preset>, and that only stays true if it is one rule rather than one copy per preset.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: The default working tree. AAV_BUILD_TESTS lives in the presets rather than on a command line so `cmake --preset debug && ctest --preset debug` reproduces what anyone else runs.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: -O2 takes different paths through the parsers than -O0, and assert() is compiled out, so this is a separate gate rather than a variant of debug.
